import os, math, numpy as np, build123d as bd
print(os.getcwd(), os.listdir("."))

R_SHAFT = 20.0        # mm, 40 mm dia sealed length (given)
R_BORE  = 20.05       # mm, 40.1 mm dia bore        (given)
L       = 60.0        # mm, bore length             (given)
KW_W    = 12.0        # mm keyway width             (given)
KW_D    = 5.0         # mm keyway depth             (given)
X_FLOOR = R_SHAFT - KW_D   # 15.0 mm flat keyway floor

keyway = bd.Box(30, KW_W, L, align=(bd.Align.MIN, bd.Align.CENTER, bd.Align.MIN)).moved(bd.Pos(X_FLOOR,0,0))
shaft  = bd.Cylinder(R_SHAFT, L, align=(bd.Align.CENTER,bd.Align.CENTER,bd.Align.MIN)) - keyway
bore   = bd.Cylinder(R_BORE , L, align=(bd.Align.CENTER,bd.Align.CENTER,bd.Align.MIN))
fluid  = bore - shaft
print("volume mm^3", fluid.volume, " bbox", fluid.bounding_box())
print("faces", len(fluid.faces()))

for i,f in enumerate(fluid.faces()):
    print(i, f.geom_type, "area=%.3f"%f.area, "center=", tuple(round(c,4) for c in f.center()),
          "normal=", tuple(round(c,4) for c in f.normal_at(f.center())),
          "radius=", getattr(f,"radius",None))

import subprocess, inspect
os.makedirs("constant/triSurface", exist_ok=True)
fl = fluid.faces()
patches = {"bore": [fl[0]], "shaft": [fl[3]], "keywayFloor": [fl[5]],
           "keywayFlanks": [fl[4], fl[6]], "highPressure": [fl[2]], "lowPressure": [fl[1]]}
MM = 0.001  # mm -> m, applied once here
for name, faces in patches.items():
    shp = bd.Compound(children=[f.scale(MM) for f in faces])
    ex = bd.Mesher(); ex.add_shape(shp, linear_deflection=2e-6, angular_deflection=0.1)
    ex.write(f"constant/triSurface/{name}.stl")
print(subprocess.run(["ls","-la","constant/triSurface"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
